question: Should schema 10 and its repair/convergence rules become the supported write-open contract for schema-4/6/8/9/10 archives after exact-head proof is supplied?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the persistent archive compatibility boundary and rollback expectations, which automated tests and review cannot authorize on the repository's behalf.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Accept the design once final-head archive preservation, integrity, normalized-schema equivalence, stable reopening, and recovery evidence is posted.

options.title: Split convergence from ordering
options.body: Land the concurrency ordering fix separately if broad legacy-schema convergence needs an independent compatibility review.

options.title: Hold schema 10
options.body: Keep the draft paused if the repository is not ready to support this new archive upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the design once final-head archive preservation, integrity, normalized-schema equivalence, stable reopening, and recovery evidence is posted.
